hooks.command: cat >/dev/null || true; ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; [ -n "$ROOT" ] || exit 0; CRG="$(command -v code-review-graph 2>/dev/null || true)"; [ -n "$CRG" ] || CRG="$ROOT/.venv/bin/code-review-graph"; [ -x "$CRG" ] || exit 0; "$CRG" update --skip-flows --repo "$ROOT" || true
